plain: The European Salivary Gland Society scheme that divides the gland into five levels
definition: The European Salivary Gland Society divides the parotid into five levels: I (lateral superior), II (lateral inferior), III (deep inferior), IV (deep superior) and V (accessory). Lateral and deep are set by the plane of the facial nerve; superior and inferior by where the main trunk divides into its temporofacial and cervicofacial branches.
